definitions.explanation: A device or appliance that mixes liquids, pastes, or powders by rotating blades or a paddle. Found in kitchens (food mixers, blenders), laboratories (magnetic stirrers, vortex mixers), construction (mortar mixers), and industrial plants (large tanks with powered impellers).

notes:
Composed of {攪拌|かくはん} (stirring, agitating) and the suffix -{器|き} (instrument, apparatus). Sometimes written {撹拌器|かくはんき} with the simplified form of the first character. The same word covers small kitchen mixers and large industrial agitators; the specific kind is usually clear from context or from a modifier such as ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧ (small) or ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧ (commercial-use).

USAGE:
Appears in technical writing (chemistry, food engineering, construction) and on product labels. In casual everyday conversation about the kitchen, speakers more often use the katakana loanwords ⟦ミキサー→ミキサー：04676_mikisaa⟧ (mixer/blender), ⟦ハンドミキサー→ハンドミキサー：29703_handomikisaa⟧ (hand mixer), or ブレンダー (blender); {攪拌器|かくはんき} sounds more formal or technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {攪拌器|かくはんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to mix with a mixer
- {攪拌器|かくはんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a mixer / stirrer
- ⟦{磁気|じき}→磁気：03334_jiki⟧{攪拌器|かくはんき}: magnetic stirrer
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{攪拌器|かくはんき}: electric mixer
- {工業用|こうぎょうよう}{攪拌器|かくはんき}: industrial-use agitator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ミキサー→ミキサー：04676_mikisaa⟧: mixer / blender — the common kitchen-appliance term
- ⟦ハンドミキサー→ハンドミキサー：29703_handomikisaa⟧: hand(-held) mixer — a small, handheld kitchen mixer
- ブレンダー: blender — typically a jar-type appliance for smoothies and purees
- ⟦{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}→泡立て器：08066_awadateki⟧: whisk — a non-powered hand tool for whipping
- {撹拌機|かくはんき}: agitator / mixing machine — a variant using -⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine); often used for larger, industrial equipment
